markets.title: Starship fully reusable before 2027?
markets.description: This contract counts an official announcement, not a proven reflight.
markets.rules: Official SpaceX or Musk announcement that the Starship upper stage is fully reusable by the deadline. An actual reuse is not required; Super Heavy reusability is not the condition. Confirm the exact provider rules.

markets.title: Will Tesla release Optimus by the end of 2026?
markets.description: Paid consumer orders count. A factory deployment or demo doesn’t.
markets.rules: Select the December 31 contract in this event. A newly introduced humanoid, bipedal consumer robot must be available to the general public through an official Tesla consumer channel with paid checkout, preorder or deposit. Unpaid waitlists, demos, internal factory deployment, employee programs and enterprise pilots do not qualify. This is a retail release market, not necessarily physical delivery.

markets.title: A new Roadster delivered before 2027?
markets.description: The next-generation car must reach a real retail customer.
markets.rules: Select the December 31, 2026 contract. At least one next-generation Roadster must be physically handed to a qualifying public retail customer, and confirmed, within the timeframe. Original 2008–2012 Roadsters, internal deliveries, employee deliveries and promotional celebrity handovers outside the normal public purchase process do not qualify.

markets.title: Grok 5 released before 2027?
markets.description: A product release deadline, with official provider rules.
markets.rules: Select the December 31, 2026 contract. Grok 5 must be a publicly accessible next flagship generation, not merely a Grok 4 variant. An open beta or open rolling waitlist can qualify; private access, placeholder naming and closed betas do not. Confirm the complete provider rules.

markets.title: Starship launches humans to Mars before 2030?
markets.description: A far-out anchor market. Read exactly what “to Mars” means.
markets.rules: Confirm the provider’s exact requirements for a qualifying crewed Mars mission, its deadline, evidence sources and cancellation handling. Launching toward Mars and landing on Mars are different milestones.

markets.title: Two Starships dock together before 2028?
markets.description: A practical step on the path to deep-space missions.
markets.rules: Select the December 31, 2027 contract. Two free-flying qualifying Starship-scale vessels must physically join through mating hardware for at least 60 continuous seconds in stable Earth orbit, with perigee at least 100 km. Credible reporting establishes success. This market is about docking, not propellant transfer; confirm the full rules at the venue.

markets.title: Tesla–SpaceX merger deal before 2028?
markets.description: A binding corporate deal, rather than a rumor or shared project.
markets.rules: Select the Before 2028 contract. This event concerns an official definitive binding transaction agreement that transfers control or consolidates the companies under common ownership. Check the selected contract’s complete rules and deadline; rumors, minority investments or collaborations do not by themselves qualify.

markets.title: How many posts this week?
markets.description: September 29–October 6, noon ET. Pick a post-count range.
markets.rules: The provider counts Musk’s X activity over its stated weekly window using XTracker. Main-feed posts, quotes and reposts count; ordinary replies do not. Deleted posts count when captured by the tracker. Verify the tracker-specific exceptions on the venue page.

markets.title: Will Starship launch toward Mars before 2029?
markets.description: A launch is one milestone. Arrival and landing are separate bets.
markets.rules: Resolves Yes if a SpaceX Starship leaves Earth on a publicly confirmed Mars-bound trajectory by December 31, 2028, 23:59 UTC. Earth orbit, a lunar mission, a stated intention or a canceled launch do not qualify. Launch telemetry and SpaceX mission reporting must establish the destination. A failed arrival can still qualify; this market concerns departure. If no qualifying public evidence exists by the deadline, resolves No.

markets.title: Will Tesla Robotaxi operate in 10 U.S. cities before 2028?
markets.description: Count real service areas, not launch announcements or private demos.
markets.rules: Resolves Yes if Tesla provides publicly bookable, paid Robotaxi rides in at least 10 distinct U.S. metropolitan statistical areas by December 31, 2027, 23:59 UTC. The service must permit rides without an in-car human safety driver or monitor; remote assistance is allowed. Use Census metropolitan area definitions, Tesla service-area documentation, and independent evidence of qualifying rides. Adjacent cities within one metro count once. Employee-only testing, announcements and demonstrations do not count. Otherwise resolves No.

markets.title: Will a passenger Hyperloop open before 2030?
markets.description: The idea counts, whoever builds it. A test-track ride doesn’t.
markets.rules: Resolves Yes if any operator runs a reduced-pressure tube transport system carrying paying members of the public between two distinct stations by December 31, 2029, 23:59 UTC. The normal service must be publicly bookable and operated on at least 30 separate days before the deadline. Conventional trains, exhibition rides, test tracks, invitation-only demonstrations and freight-only systems do not qualify. Evidence must include operator timetables or booking records and independent reporting. Otherwise resolves No.

markets.title: Will Musk attend Super Bowl LXI?
markets.description: A stadium appearance, not a post about the game.
markets.rules: Proposed observation deadline: February 28, 2027, 23:59 UTC. Resolves Yes only with publicly verifiable evidence that Elon Musk was physically present at Super Bowl LXI at SoFi Stadium during the game. Official broadcast footage, dated photographs from established news organizations, or an official NFL statement qualify. An invitation, ticket purchase, social-media commentary or attendance at a separate party does not qualify. If postponed, attendance at the rescheduled game must occur by the observation deadline. If canceled or no qualifying public evidence exists by then, resolves No.

markets.title: Will Musk attend the 2027 Met Gala?
markets.description: Red-carpet receipts. An invitation isn’t attendance.
markets.rules: Proposed observation deadline: December 31, 2027, 23:59 UTC. Resolves Yes if Elon Musk is physically present at the Metropolitan Museum of Art’s official 2027 Costume Institute benefit. Require official event imagery or dated photographic or video reporting by an established news organization. An invitation, a look-alike, an afterparty or online participation does not count. If postponed, the official 2027 event must take place before the deadline. If canceled, moved beyond the deadline or unsupported by qualifying public evidence, resolves No.

markets.title: Will Musk have a new film cameo before 2028?
markets.description: A real new appearance. Archive clips and AI likenesses don’t count.
markets.rules: Resolves Yes if a new feature-length film first commercially released between market creation and December 31, 2027, 23:59 UTC includes a newly filmed on-screen performance by Elon Musk. A cameo as himself qualifies. Documentaries, news footage, archival footage, animated depictions, AI-generated likenesses, voice-only appearances and television episodes do not qualify. Require the released film plus credits or confirmation from its studio or distributor. Release in any territory qualifies; an announcement or trailer alone does not. Otherwise resolves No.

markets.title: 50+ posts in a single day?

markets.rules: Proposed window: October 5, 2026, 00:00 UTC inclusive to October 6, 2026, 00:00 UTC exclusive. Count distinct @elonmusk post IDs published in the window: original posts, quote posts and repost actions; exclude ordinary replies. A quote counts once regardless of its text. Deleted activity counts only if captured with its ID, type and timestamp. Resolves Yes at 50 or more qualifying posts; otherwise No. Final launch must name a complete archived counting source and its main-feed reply exceptions. Cancel if the required record is unavailable rather than infer No.
